name: Money
description: Every account, card, loan and bill in one place: net worth, limits, and what is due next.
dataHelp: Amounts are plain numbers in dollars (22100, not "$22,100"). Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD"; times are full ISO date-times.
accounts: a list. Each account is { id, source, kind, institution, name, balance, updatedAt } plus optional limit, apr, note, payment, left.
- id: unique text. For one added by hand use "m" followed by digits (e.g. "m1791250000000").
- source: "manual" for anything added by hand or by you; "plaid" for accounts the bank fills in.
- kind: "checking", "savings", "investment", "asset" (something owned: a car), "credit" (a credit card), "loan" (student, car, personal) or "bnpl" (a pay-later plan: Affirm, layaway).
- institution: the company's name, spelled the usual way ("Earnest", "MOHELA", "Capital One", "American Express", "Affirm"). For an asset, what it is ("2019 Civic").
- balance: always positive. For cards, loans and pay-later plans it is the amount owed; the page shows owed money in brackets itself.
- updatedAt: set it to the current date-time whenever you change a balance, or the page will say it needs updating.
- limit: a credit card's credit limit. apr: the interest rate as a percent number (5.2). note: a few words.

- payment: the next payment on a card, loan or plan, { amount, due, monthly: true }. A pay-later plan's payment also has every: "week", "2weeks" or "month", and the account has left (payments left); its balance is amount × left.

- On an account with source "plaid" the bank shares no payment for some loans (auto loans): set payment with "manual": true and it is kept through refreshes; apr may be set too. Never change a plaid account's balance: it is refreshed from the bank.
bills: bills that are not an account (insurance, phone, subscriptions). Each is { id, provider, name, sub, category, amount, due, monthly, match }.
- id: "b" followed by digits. provider and name: the company ("Netflix"). sub: what it is ("streaming"). due: the next due date. monthly: true when it repeats every month.
- category: one of Housing, Utilities, Phone & internet, Insurance, Subscriptions, Transportation, Loans, Credit cards, Pay-later plans, Health, Other.
- match: merchant keys (lowercase, like "netflix") whose payments belong to this bill; payments are linked and bills marked paid from them automatically.

Marking a bill or payment paid: when monthly, move due forward one month, set lastPaid to today's date and add today to paidLog; otherwise set paid to today's date. A pay-later plan: subtract one from left and move due on by its every.
tx is the list of purchases the banks shared (i id, a account id, d date, m amount with money out positive, n merchant, c and k categories). Read it to answer spending questions; do not change it.
history, banks, institutions, txCursor, dismissed and checkedAt are written by the page itself: leave them alone. settings holds staleDays, warnPct, alertPct and browser.
